## WF-04: Site Metadata Enrichment

Standalone, reusable sub-workflow. Called by WF-03 (AI Classification Engine) via an 'Execute Workflow' node, passing its validated AI output.

Flow:
Execute Workflow Trigger -> Validate Input -> Lookup Site (Google Sheets) -> Merge Metadata -> [Is Site Found?] -> Calculate Customer Impact -> Calculate Business Priority -> Return Enriched Alarm

Missing input, failed lookups, and unknown sites each route to their own Error Output.

No Telegram, no Slack, no Email, no dashboard, no ticketing - enrichment only.

assignments.name: errorMessage
assignments.value: ={{$json.error ? $json.error.toString() : 'Unknown error reading the Site Metadata sheet'}}

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: =No matching row found in the Site Metadata sheet for Site ID '{{$json.siteId}}'. Alarm was classified by AI but could not be enriched or scored for customer impact/business priority.

parameters.content:
### Error handling summary
- Missing required fields from WF-03 -> Error Output - Invalid Input
- Google Sheets read fails/times out (after 3 retries, 2s apart) -> Error Output - Lookup Failed
- Site ID has no matching row in the sheet -> Error Output - Site Not Found (alarm's AI classification is preserved in the message for follow-up)

Every path returns a structured JSON object. Nothing is ever dropped silently.
